}
function take131P() {
    global $value, $target, $method, $pack;
    $saved = $value; $value = null; $target = null; $method = 'send'; $pack = 17;
    echo 'TAKE|'; return $saved;
}
function run131P() {

    try { $result = $target->{$method}(take131P(), ...$pack); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
    catch (TypeError $error) {
        $trace = $error->getTrace();

    }
    return 'done';
}
$value = new Prefix131P; $weakPrefix = WeakReference::create($value);
$target = flow131P(); $target->current(); $weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target);
$method = 'current'; $pack = null;
$fiber = new Fiber('run131P'); $returned = $fiber->start();
echo 'END|', $returned === null, '|', $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $fiber->getReturn() === 'done', '|', $weakPrefix->get() === null, '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|';
$fiber = null; echo 'DONE|';
